facts.title: The facts
family.p1: The Waldhaus first opened its doors in 1885, on the one stretch of shore where the forest runs down to the lake. A century later it was acquired by Claudio Bernasconi — a hotelier with a collector’s eye and a host’s heart, who built the whisky collection that made the house famous.
family.p2: Today his son Sandro runs the hotel. The rooms have been renewed, the spa rebuilt, the windows widened — but the welcome is exactly as it was.
family.title: From father to son
hero.lead: One lake, one house, one family — and a tradition that has quietly grown for well over a century.
meta.description: Since 1885 on Lake St. Moritz. The Bernasconi family story, our investments and the facts behind the Waldhaus.
